relationships.subject: dorsal horn iPVINs
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibitory PVINs play an important role in segregating innocuous tactile input from pain-processing circuits through presynaptic inhibition of myelinated low-threshold mechanoreceptors

relationships.subject: dorsal horn ePVINs
relationships.evidence_quote: Of the 201 Slc17a6-expressing PV cells analysed from 3 mice (75, 54, and 72), 74.5% (±2.3%) expressed CCK

relationships.subject: dorsal horn PVINs
relationships.evidence_quote: In brief step responses, PVIN photostimulation increased rheobase current

relationships.subject: dorsal horn ePVINs
relationships.evidence_quote: aberrant activity of ePVINs under pathological conditions is well placed to contribute to the development of mechanical hypersensitivity

key_findings: Excitatory PVINs make up ~53% of mouse dorsal horn PV interneurons (laminae IIi-III), and ~75% of them express CCK.
PVIN photostimulation evokes monosynaptic GABA/glycinergic oIPSCs and glutamatergic oEPSCs in dorsal horn neurons; ePVIN and iPVIN populations interconnect.
